attchmntText: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited. has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Federal-Mogul Goetze India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 54,736.40 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Profit before tax stood at 7,217.83 lakhs for the same period. Profit after tax was recorded at 5,370.48 lakhs. Earnings per share were 9.65 for the quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 106,317.22 lakhs. Profit before tax was 12,815.58 lakhs. Profit after tax was 9,506.71 lakhs. Earnings per share for the half year were 17.08. Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued an unmodified review conclusion on these results.
